description: We’re working on an interactive platform to learn about lunar missions and their feasibility.
summary: MOONLOVER is an interactive lunar mission simulator that combines NASA data, 3D visualization, and orbital calculations to explore potential Moon landing sites. Through open hardware and educational tools, it brings space exploration closer and understandable to everyone.
details:
MOONLOVER


Bringing the wonders of space exploration
closer to everyone.


Our platform is an interactive lunar mission planning and simulation platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge (Lunar Landing Site Navigator), focused on the challenging environment of the Lunar South Pole, So we transforms complex scientific data into an intuitive experience, helping users explore potential Artemis and CLPS landing sites through three key factors: solar illumination, terrain safety, and Direct-to-Earth (DTE) communication windows.

Powered by official NASA datasets, including JPL Horizons, NASA Moon Trek, LROC QuickMap, and LOLA elevation models, the platform combines precise lunar and orbital data with an open, scalable architecture designed to evolve alongside future space exploration technologies.

Built with React, Vite, and Three.js, MOON LOVER brings the mission to life through an interactive 3D lunar globe, realistic space lighting, synchronized Earth-to-Moon launch windows, and live telemetry tracking sunlight conditions and communication availability. Users can also generate structured json mission plans, making the experience both interactive and practical.

But we want that MOONLOVER goes beyond the screen. We wanna transform into a open-hardware and softwars vision brings the lunar experience into the physical world through a 3D-printable desktop simulator, and robotics proyects, featuring an ESP32/Arduino-powered dual-axis lunar globe, a motorized sunlight simulation arm, and a retro-inspired T9 keypad. An accompanying open-source educational hub will bring together printable designs, firmware, research, and collaborative projects for schools, universities, makers, and space enthusiasts.


This is more than a mission planner,
MOON LOVER is an open invitation to explore,
experiment, and bring space science closer to everyday life.
